The final token `?flag` is the beginning of a second URL example (`https://example.com/?flag`), which is incomplete — the model must decide whether to add more parameters, a value, or end it, contrasting with the first URL's `?foo=1&bar=2&flag`.

"Before: `https://example.com/?foo=1&bar=2&flag`"
"After: `https://example.com/?flag`" — likely continuing with a value or additional parameter mirroring the first example's "flag" concept.</explanation>
